en.title: "Weekly 4Gamer" looking back at 4Gamer's week, August 3rd to August 9th, 2026
en.summary: From August 3rd to August 9th, 2026, there were 302 articles published on 4Gamer. Continuing from the week before last, we will be posting a number of articles, event reports, interviews, etc. on ``ChinaJoy2026,'' and we will take a quick look back at 4Gamer, which operated normally despite the heat, and the eventful week in the global game industry.

items.title: Access Accepted第869回：AI特需とゲームハードウェアの受難。クラウドゲーミングは代替策になるのか？
items.summary: 生成AIブームに伴い，我々ゲーマーのプレイ環境は「メムフレーション」という名の深刻な価格高騰に巻き込まれている。その結果，クラウドゲーミングが再び脚光を浴び始めているようだが，ハードウェアの高額化とゲーム離れを救う特効薬になり得るのだろうか。

zh.title: 接受第869号：AI的特殊需求和游戏硬件的艰辛。云游戏是替代方案吗？
zh.summary: 随着生成式人工智能的蓬勃发展，我们游戏玩家的游戏环境陷入了被称为“memflation”的严重价格上涨。因此，云游戏似乎再次成为人们关注的焦点，但它能否成为拯救人们免受硬件成本增加和人们放弃游戏的灵丹妙药呢？

en.title: Access Accepted No. 869: Special demand for AI and the hardships of game hardware. Is cloud gaming an alternative?
en.summary: With the boom in generative AI, the playing environment for us gamers has become embroiled in a serious price hike known as ``memflation.'' As a result, cloud gaming seems to be once again in the spotlight, but can it be a silver bullet to save people from increasing hardware costs and people turning away from gaming?

Generally speaking, the gameplay in simulation management and plant-related games is to plant vegetables, flowers, and trees, water them on time, and wait a few days, and a batch of neat things will grow in the ground. In reality, I also like plants. But I don’t like planting flowers that much. This is because I can’t stand a plant that doesn’t grow well for more than half a year, just to wait for a short flowering period. In comparison, buying fresh cut flowers is much easier. I also prefer to spend dozens of dollars to buy a few bunches of peonies, put them in a vase, and watch them bloom into their most beautiful flowers within a few days, and then throw them away. Water lilies are also beautiful, but none of the water lilies I bought in recent times have bloomed. I’m not sure what’s wrong, but fresh cut flowers always give me a sense of joy.

en.title: Review of ``SMARTCOBY Pro SLIM SS'', ​​a compact semi-solid mobile battery that has a large capacity of 10000mAh and can charge up to 3 devices at the same time
en.summary: As we approach summer and the days continue to be hot, there have been reports of mobile batteries and handy fans catching fire on trains and in stations, and the problem has become such a problem that Tokyu Corporation has asked people to refrain from using mobile batteries on trains.
